# Methodology: the pre-registered falsification protocol

::: {.callout-note}
Chapter in preparation. Planned contents:
:::

- **28.1** The discipline of pre-registration: hypotheses and predictions committed (commit or sha256) before running — §46, §75–§164
- **28.2** Passes and failures: "123 passed / 53 failed" covers **only §75–§123** (the QML line)
- **28.3** Test beds: calibrated noise models of IBM (Brisbane, Sherbrooke, Torino, Fez, a fleet of 21) and IonQ (Aria-1, Forte-1) — §20, §137, §144
- **28.4** Real-hardware runs: IonQ Forte-1 (§128) was refused by the provider before the job was accepted; the first real data point is the three-flavour neutrino run on IQM Garnet — §165
- **28.5** The falsification criterion for QPUs: variance of the inversion echo Var_θ(F_echo) over continuous trajectories
- **28.6** First run on real hardware: IQM Resonance (Garnet/Emerald) — see Chapter 31
